Primordial avatar of the forest's spirit. Focused only on plants, nicknamed "leshy lords" in folktales and stories.

AC 15, HP 81, ATK 3 vine +8 (2d6) or 3 thorn (far) +8 (2d6), MV near, S +5, D +5, C +5, I +4, W +5, Ch +5, AL N, LV 17

Green Caress. Mortals within double near, CHA 15+ or transform into non-magical plant over 1d6 rounds. On success or if green man chooses, immune for 24 hours.

Green Empathy. Command plant creatures within near, CHA 15+ to resist.

Summon Plants. 1/day, as an action, summon a loyal treant or 1d10 leshies, stay for 5 rounds.

Supreme Being. Only damaged by magical sources.
